first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A low blue-and-white open-wheel single-seat race car with exposed black tires; from the rear view, a transverse rear wing and a central red taillight are visible.

entities.name: Vehicle C
entities.identification: A blue-cyan open-wheel race car with a yellow patch on the nose and a bright yellow rear wing; at the end of the clip, it is to the image-left of Vehicle D.

entities.name: Vehicle D
entities.identification: A yellow-and-black open-wheel race car that partially enters the frame from the lower-left edge and is visibly out of frame at the bottom at the end of the clip.

entities.name: gray asphalt racetrack
entities.identification: The broad gray curved road surface extending across the frame, with white lines along its edges.

entities.name: grass shoulder
entities.identification: The darker green grassy area outside the racetrack, distinct from the light green paved runoff area.

entities.name: white racetrack sign
entities.identification: The white rectangular upright panel on the inside of the curve in the second shot, with a small dark and dark-red graphic in the center.

entities.name: blue-and-white segmented curb
entities.identification: The narrow curb that curves along the racetrack boundary, with alternating blue and white sections.

entities.name: green paved runoff area
entities.identification: The relatively flat, continuous light green paved area outside the curb.

entities.name: distant metal mesh fence
entities.identification: The fine-meshed fence extending horizontally in the distant view of the second shot, with dark posts and horizontal members.

entities.name: black advertising barrier wall
entities.identification: The dark horizontal wall strip below the fence in the second shot, with repeated white FANATEC lettering.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The driver in Vehicle A's cockpit, with only part of a light-colored helmet exposed and most of the body occluded by the cockpit.

entities.name: red-and-white canopy
entities.identification: The group of red-and-white partitioned peaked canopies behind the fence in the second shot.

entities.name: gray paved ground behind the guardrail
entities.identification: The light gray horizontal paved area behind the fence in the second shot.
